title: How are you keeping focus?
author: EffectNo2152
selftext:
i cant stop implementing new things.

im gonna end up with a cooking, climbing, cleaning, wingsuit, airplane, drone, skiing, golfing, boating, gardening, motorcycling, bowling, billiards, poker, gta6, girlfriend simulator at this point

(not really) but i feel ive implemented too much too fast on what was supposed to be a simple iphone egg flipping test

comments.author: EffectNo2152
comments.body:
https://jalapenoseed.github.io/yolk-flip/

it started a simple javascript test then i went crazy

comments.author: No_Peace_6770
comments.body: Create a game design document laying out the scope

replies.author: EffectNo2152
replies.body: ill try this. you lay out A-Z before the first shot or what?

replies.author: Alyosha2020
replies.body:
Doesn't need to be A-Z. For the egg game, I'd keep the first version to flip, land, score, retry. Put the other ideas in a 'later' list and let someone play that version before adding more. Do they actually want another go?



Since you're making the doc from the current repo, ask it to separate what's already built from what's needed for that loop. Otherwise it might just turn all the scope creep into a very convincing plan lol.

replies.author: EffectNo2152
replies.body: took your suggestion of making a mini intro game. still shaping it but its live. thanks

comments.author: jildos_legoplanet
comments.body: I work the same way as i would with a dev team. Have a Github project setup with a clear target followed by iterations (sprints) that describe a common / overarching goal. I have assigned ChatGPT as my Product Manager to keep me in check to avoid going into scope creep/drift. Maybe this is oldskool and one-shot vibecoders will laugh at me but the end product is focused with good quality.

replies.author: xendelaar
replies.body: But scope creep is soooo heavenly addictive!! Just one more feature! Let me just Overhaul the entire game because I had a cool idea on the shitter. It keeps me awake at night.. starting with a simple tic tac toe and ending with a mmorpg :D

replies.author: jildos_legoplanet
replies.body: I soo get what you mean, to avoid myself from waking up at night, that’s exactly the reason i’ve build this guardrail in from myself ;) still have a job and 2 kids to take care of

replies.author: xendelaar
replies.body:
I'm in the same boat, my dude. Two kids means only couples of hours a week to go full nerd mode.
How do you build your gardrails? Scope creeps seems inevitable when i realise my current road map or results are just not as exciting as I envisioned...

comments.author: Revolutionary-Skin97
comments.body:
Imagine it like this, your game is the qi energy you have.

right now amassing them in one place, its getting bigger and bigger, more features, the wider it becomes, the energy now looks like a spirit bomb.

But since you're not refining it, anyone you hit wont budge.

Now to reach a higher realm, you must learn how to stop amassing your qi energy and focus on condensing it.

Im not talking about qi energy.

comments.author: Easy-Coconut-33
comments.body:
I have a ai_roadmap.md in my game folder. With a good clear roadmap so if i want to implement new code ai check the roadmad. Im making a 2D action adventure rpg where i build the visual and ai doing all the coding. Works great so far. Using deepseek 4.1 flash.

I also forced deepseek to read all the doc about using unity and save that to a memory doc in the game folder. Im getting better results after doing so.

comments.author: QueenSavara
comments.body: I have ADHD and autism. The focus is keeping me hostage.
